{{short description|Filipina mathematician}}
'''Marian P. Roque''' is a Filipina mathematician. She was the president of the [[Mathematical Society of the Philippines]],{{r|pres}} a professor in the Institute of Mathematics of the [[University of the Philippines Diliman]],{{r|upsci}} and former Director of the Institute of Mathematics.{{r|structure}} Her mathematical specialty is the theory of [[partial differential equation]]s.{{r|nrcp}}

Roque's interest in a career in Mathematics began in her grade school participation in the first National Quiz Bee.<ref name=":0" /> She continued her studies in mathematics at the University of the Philippines Diliman, where she earned her bachelor's (1986), master's (1989), and doctoral degrees (1996).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Roque, Marian |url=https://math.upd.edu.ph/faculty/roque-marian |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=Institute of Mathematics |language=en-US}}</ref> Through the Sandwich Scholarship Program, she did her research work for her dissertation at the [[University of Essen]], where she studied under Bernd Schultze. While studying in Germany, she faced discrimination due to her gender and nationality.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Science |first=College of |date=2022-03-08 |title=WOMEN IN STEM: DR. MARIAN P. ROQUE |url=https://science.upd.edu.ph/women-in-stem-dr-marian-p-roque/ |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=UP Science |language=en-US}}</ref> She then completed a postdoctoral fellowship at [[Waseda University]].

With Doina Cioranescu and Patrizia Donato, she is the author of ''An Introduction to Second Order Partial Differential Equations: Classical and Variational Solutions'' (World Scientific, 2018).{{r|i2pde}}



== Awards ==

* 2012: Gawad Tsanselor para sa Natatanging Guro
* 2014-2016: UP Scientist<ref>{{Cite web |author1=Lexter |date=2018-01-03 |title=The Cardinality of Infinite Sets {{!}} Dr. Marian Roque |url=https://networks.upou.edu.ph/10305/the-cardinality-of-infinite-sets-dr-marian-roque/ |access-date=2022-06-24 |website=UPOU Networks |language=en-US}}</ref>
* 2016: National Research Council of the Philippines Outstanding Achievement Award.{{r|nrcp}}
